scope: Maintenance recurrence, postponement, pending successor release/stop, order cancellation; independent logistics review.

changes.problem: The UI allowed a generic interval up to 3650 although the server applies unit-specific limits.
changes.implementation: One shared validator and accessible changing limit hint apply days≤3650, weeks≤520, months≤120 in creation and cycle forms; payload/API unchanged.

changes.problem: A queued close event from a previous management dialog could clear the current form controller and presentation after immediate reopening.
changes.implementation: Cleanup checks whether its own form is still the active connected form before removing its guard; only removes shared dialog styling when no management form remains.

changes.problem: Postponement could be confused with stopping/cancelling and its final step label used an unrelated shared translation.
changes.implementation: Specific postponement help explains preservation of saved work and new anchor; specific final step says Conferir programação da manutenção; existing stop-next-order and cancel-current-order actions remain distinct.

changes.problem: Stopped pending successor status was not expressed explicitly alongside blocked/created states.
changes.implementation: Explicit pending follow-up stopped label, visible as text and translated into Portuguese.

preservation: No migrations, server code, ACL or password/session policy changed.

Unexpected successor creation failure rolls back completion, audit, receipt and newly created order together.
Old completed work remains unchanged when the next pending order is stopped; cancelling an open order preserves existing saved work.
Actual completion and fixed-date monthly anchors tested separately.
